Panel venues carrying a coordinate. From the City of Austin geocoded sound-ordinance permit file, matched on a normalised street address (65) then on a normalised venue name (2). The coordinates are still used by the Moody Center distance design in 70_quasi_experiments.do. The address field in venue_timeline.csv was not used; the evidence memo flags it as unreliable.
